items.markdown:
![Explore Nong Khai: 12 Best Things to Do & More](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07270419-1672-0139-0000-3d97a8cf06b4:4)
Absolutely. Nong Khai is a fantastic, relaxed destination offering a mix of surreal art, vibrant riverside markets, and authentic Isan culture away from the tourist crowds. `If you enjoy slow-paced travel, stunning Mekong sunsets, and rich local food, it is well worth a 2- to 3-day stay`.[](https://www.adventuresofjellie.com/thailand/nong-khai-guide) [[1]](https://www.adventuresofjellie.com/thailand/nong-khai-guide)[[2]](https://medium.com/@bosearitra44/the-complete-guide-to-nong-khai-far-more-than-a-border-stop-7a39a543837e)

**Key Highlights & Logistics:** 

- **Sala Kaew Ku:** Located about 3 km from the city center, this surreal sculpture park features massive, bizarre, and beautiful concrete statues mixing Buddhist and Hindu mythologies.[](https://travel-explore.asia/2025/04/28/the-beauty-of-nong-khai/) [[1]](https://travel-explore.asia/2025/04/28/the-beauty-of-nong-khai/)[[2]](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Attractions-g303915-Activities-Nong_Khai_Nong_Khai_Province.html)[[3]](https://sa.trip.com/moments/detail/nong-khai-24549-135436289?locale=en-SA)[[4]](https://responsiblethailand.com/let-the-train-take-the-strain-in-isaan/)[[5]](https://medium.com/@bosearitra44/the-complete-guide-to-nong-khai-more-than-just-a-border-stop-6693e16d70f5)
- **The Mekong Riverfront:** The river promenade is lined with cafes, bars, and street food stalls. It comes alive at sunset and is the perfect place to relax, especially with the iconic giant **Naga statues** watching over the water.[](https://www.adventuresofjellie.com/thailand/nong-khai-guide) 
- **Tha Sadet Market:** A bustling indoor market stretching along the river, perfect for shopping for local handicrafts, textiles, and goods imported from across the nearby Laos border.[](https://www.adventuresofjellie.com/thailand/nong-khai-guide) [[1]](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Attractions-g303915-Activities-Nong_Khai_Nong_Khai_Province.html)
- **Sunken Temple (Phra That Klang Nam):** A 15th-century stupa that tumbled into the Mekong and can be seen peaking out of the water, particularly during the dry season.[](https://www.adventuresofjellie.com/thailand/nong-khai-guide) 
- **Travel to Nong Khai:** It serves as the primary gateway to Laos via the **First Thai-Lao Friendship Bridge** . To get there, most travelers fly into **Udon Thani International Airport** , which is about 50 km (an hour’s drive) south, and grab a local bus, van, or taxi from there.[](https://travel-explore.asia/2025/04/28/the-beauty-of-nong-khai/) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/5DicawxHnFY)[[2]](https://southeastasiabackpacker.com/destinations/thailand-2/northern-thailand/nong-khai/)

You can check out traveler photos and reviews of local attractions on [Tripadvisor](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Attractions-g303915-Activities-Nong_Khai_Nong_Khai_Province.html).
